crossOriginIsolation.description: App-wide policy read after all App windows close. Required documents must establish browser cross-origin isolation before becoming ready.

id.description: Stable global App identity and reaweb:// authority. If omitted, ordinary WebUIs persist a random ID in .reawebapi/identity.json; JSFX WebUI retains its fx_ident-derived ID.

dawKeyboard.description: Initial Space routing for ordinary Apps. Runtime overrides reset from this configuration on page reload.

videoHighRefreshRate.description: Allow a new macOS video window to opt out of WebKit's near-60-Hz scheduling preference when supported. Does not guarantee a display frame rate.

entry.description: Existing .html/.htm path relative to this manifest. Forward slashes only; absolute paths, parent traversal, and links outside the App directory are rejected by validate_app.py.
